title: Battle of Ganja (1826)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ganja (1826)", at revision 1370441287, opens: "The Battle of Ganja or Elisavetpol took place on 25 September 1826NS/13 September 1826OS, during the Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4438370, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1826 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
